rows.grounds: present passive participle describing one undergoing cutting
optative passive expressing potential or hypothetical effect
compound indicating absorption or attainment of that state
possessive compound indicating whose mind is directed to that

items.question: Can a person absorbed in that state be harmed by physical cutting?
premises: The subject is described as being physically cut.
The subject has gone to that state and has the mind fixed on that.
Absorption in that state alters the effect of physical injury.
items.inference: One who has attained that state and fixed the mind on it is not truly cut even while being cut.
uncertainties: The referent of 'that' (tad) depends on the preceding verses and is not explicit here.
items.plain_english: One who has gone to that and whose mind is fixed on that is not cut, even while being cut.
